options.name: annotations
options.description: Specifiy annotations for CCE node

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: How long should the socket layer wait before timing out for API calls. If this is omitted, nothing will be passed to the requests library.

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary containing auth information as needed by the cloud's auth plugin strategy. For the default I(password) plugin, this would contain I(auth_url), I(username), I(password), I(project_name) and any information about domains (for example, I(os_user_domain_name) or I(os_project_domain_name)) if the cloud supports them. For other plugins, this param will need to contain whatever parameters that auth plugin requires. This parameter is not needed if a named cloud is provided or OpenStack OS_* e

options.name: auth_type
options.description: Name of the auth plugin to use. If the cloud uses something other than password authentication, the name of the plugin should be indicated here and the contents of the I(auth) parameter should be updated accordingly.

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: Availability zone

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: A path to a CA Cert bundle that can be used as part of verifying SSL API requests.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: A path to a client certificate to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: client_key
options.description: A path to a client key to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: cloud
options.description: Named cloud or cloud config to operate against. If I(cloud) is a string, it references a named cloud config as defined in an OpenStack clouds.yaml file. Provides default values for I(auth) and I(auth_type). This parameter is not needed if I(auth) is provided or if OpenStack OS_* environment variables are present. If I(cloud) is a dict, it contains a complete cloud configuration like would be in a section of clouds.yaml.

options.name: cluster
options.description: CCE cluster name or id which hosts the cce cluster node

options.name: count
options.description: Cluster node count which will be created. If node count is greater than 1 the name of the node gets a suffix.

options.name: data_volumes
options.description: List of data volumes attached to the cluster node.

options.name: dedicated_host
options.description: ID of a Dedicated Host where the cluster node will be located to.

options.name: ecs_group
options.description: ID of the ECS group where the CCE node can belong to.

options.name: fault_domain
options.description: The node is created in the specified fault domain.

options.name: flavor
options.description: Flavor ID of the cluster node

options.name: floating_ip
options.description: Floating IP used to connect to public networks.

options.name: interface
options.description: Endpoint URL type to fetch from the service catalog.

options.name: k8s_tags
options.description: Dictionary of Kubernetes tags.

options.name: labels
options.description: Labels for the CCE cluster node

options.name: lvm_config
options.description: ConfigMap of the Docker data disk.

options.name: max_pods
options.description: Maximum number of pods on the node.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the CCE cluster node.

options.name: network
options.description: Network ID of the CCE cluster node.

options.name: node_image_id
options.description: ID of a custom image used in a baremetall scenario.

options.name: offload_node
options.description: If node is offloading its components.

options.name: os
options.description: Operating System of the cluster node.

options.name: postinstall_script
options.description: Base64 encoded post installation script.

options.name: preinstall_script
options.description: Base64 encoded pre installation script.

options.name: region_name
options.description: Name of the region.

options.name: root_volume_size
options.description: Size of the root volume

options.name: root_volume_type
options.description: Type of the root volume.

options.name: sdk_log_level
options.description: Log level of the OpenStackSDK

options.name: sdk_log_path
options.description: Path to the logfile of the OpenStackSDK. If empty no log is written

options.name: ssh_key
options.description: Name of the public key to login

options.name: state
options.description: Should the resource be present or absent.

options.name: tags
options.description: CCE cluster node tags

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time the module should wait.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not SSL API requests should be verified. Before Ansible 2.3 this defaulted to C(yes).

options.name: wait
options.description: If the module should wait for the cluster node to be created or deleted.
